mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rk_client_session (client_id, token, expire_at) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{token}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, client_id, token, expire_at, created_at FROM rk_client_session WHERE token = #{token} AND expire_at > NOW() LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM rk_client_session WHERE expire_at <= NOW()
